title: Spicy Korean-Style Rigatoni JJigae
description: A spicy and flavorful Korean-inspired rigatoni jjigae recipe for a hearty and comforting meal.
instructions: Cook the rigatoni according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the chili flakes, fish sauce, soy sauce, and gochujang, and stir to combine.
Add the cooked rigatoni to the pan and stir to combine with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until the flavors have melded together.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
